curated.name: Byrd Theatre: the spring room
curated.note: The spring room (foundation, Tours): an underground spring breached in the 1927 excavation, and a retention pond of 30 by 30 feet, seen from a concrete opening past the boiler on the general manager's tour (Style Weekly, 2014; a 2019 travel piece gives a room 25 feet square). He says the water was never used for the air conditioning; a Byrd engineer on Cinema Treasures says its water can be pumped for it, and Wikipedia that it used to be. Its side of the stage and its depth are approximate.

curated.name: Byrd Theatre: auditorium
curated.note: An opera-style box beside the stage, with a large mural behind it (nomination): a grand piano in one and a harp in the other, played from the organ console (nomination). The piano is in the left box and the harp in the right, as Rudisill (1986: "boxes to the left and right of the stage"), Richmond magazine (2021: the harp "in the right balcony") and a 2019 account (piano in the left alcove, harp and marimba in the right) agree; drawn so, house left and house right. The harp does not play: a marimba below it makes the harp's sound (Richmond Family Magazine, 2015; Mid-Atlantic Traveler, 2019).

The piano is in the left box and the harp in the right, as Rudisill (1986: "boxes to the left and right of the stage"), Richmond magazine (2021: the harp "in the right balcony") and a 2019 account (piano in the left alcove, harp and marimba in the right) agree; drawn so, house left and house right. The harp does not play: a marimba below it makes the harp's sound (Richmond Family Magazine, 2015; Mid-Atlantic Traveler, 2019).

curated.name: Byrd Theatre: auditorium
curated.note: The balcony, an integral part of the theatre's visual effect (nomination); today 476 seats (Wikipedia). Its depth, rake and rows are approximate; the 1928 photograph shows its curved front, drawn straight.

curated.name: Byrd Theatre: auditorium
curated.note: The 1928 seats, by the American Seating Company, 19 inches wide: cast-iron end standards in a polychrome finish holding the aisle lights, maple scrolled armrests, and backs in a gold and crimson floral velvet (the curator, Curator's Corner, 2025). Drawn with a crimson seat and back, trimmed gold along the top; rows and aisles approximate.
